sentences.text: Beauty and the Beast is a 2017 American musical romantic fantasy film directed by Bill Condon from a screenplay written by Stephen Chbosky and Evan Spiliotopoulos , and co-produced by Walt Disney Pictures and Mandeville Films .	Bill Condon	Bill Condon	Stephen Chbosky	Stephen Chbosky	Evan Spiliotopoulos	Evan Spiliotopoulos	Beauty and the Beast	Beauty and the Beast	Walt Disney Pictures	Walt Disney Pictures	Mandeville Films	Mandeville Films	musical	Musical film	romantic fantasy	romantic fantasy

The film is based on Disney 's 1991 animated film of the same name , itself an adaptation of Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont 's eighteenth-century fairy tale .	Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont	Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont	1991 animated film of the same name	Beauty and the Beast (1991 film)	fairy tale	Beauty and the Beast

The film features an ensemble cast that includes Emma Watson and Dan Stevens as the titular characters with Luke Evans , Kevin Kline , Josh Gad , Ewan McGregor , Stanley Tucci , Audra McDonald , Gugu Mbatha-Raw , Nathan Mack , Ian McKellen and Emma Thompson in supporting roles . Principal photography began at Shepperton Studios in Surrey , England on May 18 , 2015 , and ended on August 21 .	Principal photography	Principal photography	Shepperton Studios	Shepperton Studios	Surrey	Surrey

Beauty and the Beast premiered on February 23 , 2017 , at Spencer House in London and was released in the United States on March 17 , 2017 , in the standard , Disney Digital 3-D , RealD 3D , IMAX and IMAX 3D formats along with Dolby Cinema .
